synopsis: The research included South America in its search for collision-warning and automatic-braking standards and regulations applicable to earth-moving, mining and construction machines [f2036]. The search sought document scope, current edition, status, and performance and testing requirements [f2036]. Chapter 3 and the glossary agree that South America has no continent-wide machinery regime; Chapter 3 adds that Brazil, Chile and Peru use national workplace and mining regulation [f2285, f15577]. These facts establish a national rather than continent-wide regulatory context, but do not identify specific national documents or acceptance requirements [f2285, f15577, f2036].

relations.note: Both state that South America has no continent-wide machinery regime.
The regional finding specifies the national regulatory context encountered by the standards search.
